## 中文

### 变更背景

说明这个 PR 解决的项目问题、业务场景和技术压力。

### 核心设计

说明为什么这样实现，关键机制是什么，是否涉及一致性、幂等、限流、缓存、重试或补偿。

### 验证方式

- [ ] 已运行受影响模块的 `go test ./...`
- [ ] 已检查 README/项目说明是否需要中英文同步更新
- [ ] 已确认没有提交本地配置、密钥、证书私钥、运行时数据和日志

### 风险与后续

说明剩余风险、边界条件和后续待办。

## English

### Background

Describe the project problem, business scenario, and technical pressure addressed by this PR.

### Core Design

Explain why this implementation was chosen and which mechanisms are involved, such as consistency, idempotency, rate limiting, caching, retry, or compensation.

### Verification

- [ ] Ran `go test ./...` in affected modules
- [ ] Checked whether README/project documentation needs bilingual updates
- [ ] Confirmed that no local configs, secrets, private keys, runtime data, or logs were committed

### Risks and Follow-ups

Describe remaining risks, edge cases, and follow-up work.
